text: A city maintenance worker missed checkout after inspecting floodway pumps.
A dead radio frequency starts broadcasting confessions from tomorrow.
A demolition notice appears on a house that has more rooms inside than outside.
A deer at the city edge smiles with a missing person's tooth.
Security footage shows a food court below a mall that has no lower level.
Every old map in the civic archive changes overnight around the same blank oval.
Rain, static, missing names, and impossible exits begin appearing together.
